summary.text: As Secretary of Energy, Chris Wright described the Genesis Mission as using DOE national laboratories, supercomputers, and data resources to pursue U.S. leadership in artificial intelligence (s1, s90). He linked AI development to expanded reliable energy supplies, including nuclear power, and to public-private partnerships (s10, s21, s34). He also described AI as a tool for scientific and nuclear-engineering advances and discussed accelerating energy infrastructure for data centers (s4, s7, s43).

statements.text: Throughout history, from the Manhattan Project to the Apollo mission, our nation’s brightest minds and industries have answered the call when their nation needed them,” said U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright. “Today, the United States is calling on them once again. Under President Trump’s leadership, the Genesis Mission will unleash the full power of our National Laboratories, supercomputers, and data resources to ensure that America is the global leader in artificial intelligence and to usher in a new golden era of American discovery.

With President Trump’s leadership, the United States will win the global AI race, but first, we must unleash our energy dominance and restore American competitiveness.
